additional_info.subject: Translation
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I'm contacting you because charging point 2 of the station is out of order.
The error code displayed is "secc is offline." The charging point
is indeed experiencing an error and cannot be used.
Could you please diagnose the problem and schedule
an intervention if necessary?
As you can see in the screenshot, the error appeared
on 06/11/25 at 02:21:10 and it still occurs at this time, 06/11/25 at
09:21:00
Thank you in advance.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0430427-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312571675/11]Charging point malfunctioning. CRM:02698000235
additional_info.body:
Dear Thibaut Hurand,
I hope you are doing well.
Regarding the error, I’ve reviewed the logs, and it appears that the SECC lost communication for a few microseconds at that time.
If there’s a brief loss of communication with the SECC, the SiC D will reconnect within 5 seconds. During this time, an "SECC is offline" flag may appear on your backend, but it will be cleared once the reconnection is successful.
In this charger, I observed that the issue is resolved within a few seconds, and there is no impact on the ongoing session.
This issue has now been resolved, and both outlets are currently healthy and available.
currently there is error of power converter we will try to fix it remotely, we can not do anything as this time because there is ongoing charging session on outlet 1.
We appreciate your patience and understanding. Please feel free to reach out if you have any further questions or concerns.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
